items.body:
Smart Cache on ROCKNIX correctly discovers recently-played GameCube/Wii games (via .gci save mtimes / Wii NAND title dirs), but can't actually cache them: our shared native hasher (`raproxy_rchash.so`, rc_hash + libchdr) only reads raw `.iso`/`.gcm`, and ROCKNIX's entire GC/Wii library is Dolphin's own compressed `.rvz`/`.wia` format.

Android already solved this with pure Kotlin container decompression that feeds decompressed bytes into the existing native hasher (`app/src/main/java/com/raofflineproxy/proxy/hash/RvzRomDataSource.kt`, ~900 lines: WIA/RVZ header parsing, zstd group decompression, Wii AES partition decryption, hash-tree reconstruction).

Plan: port that logic to Python and wire it through the already-compiled `raproxy_hash_disc_datasource` C hook (`third_party/rcheevos_glue/rchash_glue.h`) via `ctypes.CFUNCTYPE` — no native rebuild needed.

Device check (ROCKNIX `next`, SM8550 aarch64): no pip, and neither `zstandard` nor `cryptography` Python packages are available. However both `libzstd.so.1` and `libcrypto.so.3` (OpenSSL 3) exist as system shared libraries at `/usr/lib/`, so we can bind directly via ctypes instead of vendoring wheels (consistent with the no-pip constraint that drove the pygame wheel-vendoring approach for the SDL menu).

Scope: RVZ/WIA only for now, since that's the format ROCKNIX's Dolphin actually produces/uses. GCZ/WBFS/CISO (also covered on Android) are lower priority.

Comparable effort to the Android Kotlin port — not a quick fix.
items.title: ROCKNIX: Smart Cache can't hash RVZ/WIA GameCube/Wii ROMs

items.body:
Hello, I was having an issue when trying to add Mario Kart Wii (Mario Kart Wii (USA) (En,Fr,Es).rvz) to cached games, it would crash the application, same with donkey kong country (.rvz) and a few others which could be caused by incorrect hash not sure, but after trying to relaunch the app it would continue to crash everytime, tried restarting the device and reopening but it would keep crashing, to get it working again I had to uninstall and redownload RAOfflineProxy, I was hoping to make you aware of this so others don’t have to re-add the cached games like I did. I should also say this happened on multiple hashes of Mario kart Wii, Europe and USA.

Another issue I faced was after updating the app to latest version, I tried loaded a Wii game and noticed the proxy was idle and not caching, I connected to internet and saw on dolphin settings I was logged out of retro achievements, this happened a few times having to log in again and again and eventually it worked again but not quite sure what I did, maybe this is a me issue or it’s something you could resolve? I’m not really that technical with this stuff.

Running android 13 on AYN Thor

Ps. Just wanted to say that I love this project and have dreamed of offline retro achievements for so long and it’s finally come true, what you’re doing is amazing and I can’t thank you enough, keep doing what you’re doing.
items.title: Mario Kart Wii causing crashing and Dolphin signing out of RA
